title: Fur Friends ⚔️ Battle Edition Day 27 | The Elemental Shrine | Cozy Kawaii RPG Animation & Lofi
description:
At the Elemental Shrine the fire and water crystals have stopped glowing. Eli the Elementalist joins the party, a Flame Burst and Gale Sweep calm the Elemental Spirit, and the shrine lights up the night sky.

0:00 The Silent Shrine
0:45 Eli the Elementalist
1:30 The Elemental Spirit
2:15 Shrine Lights

⚔️ Fur Friends: Battle Edition — the Fur Friends are adventuring in Pawlandia Online, a cozy fantasy MMORPG world. A new friend joins every episode!
🐾 No one gets hurt: bonked monsters just get dizzy, then become friends.
🎧 Best with headphones. Original lofi music & cozy fantasy sounds.
